race.comment: TEMPTED (10) one of the best sprinting mares in the country who made a mess of them first up when taking out the G2 Concorde Stakes over 1000m at this track in grand style. Since fitted with a 1030m trial and gets the right set-up with the fast tempo. The one to beat. SAVVY HALLIE (13) bounced back quickly second up at the big odds when leading throughout over 1200m in the G2 Sheraco Stakes at Rosehill. Best figures measure up and Rawiller retains the ride. Each way. MARHOONA (12) peaked on the run first up when sixth in the G2 Concorde over 1000m. Improver. CABALLUS (2) produced a moderate performance at his last start when sixth to Jigsaw over 1200m at Ascot five-and-a-half months ago. Trialling well and performs well fresh. Include.
